reason: The batch report from a named lab is what I usually go hunting for and rarely find, and a counted sachet fits my day better than a bottle I forget on the counter. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, not two.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And it is made in China, so I would open the lab report and check the batch number before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab turned out to be not real or not independent, I would drop it.
